messages:
alexa: Hey team — quick PSA: final changelog cutoff in ~2 hours. Please add one-line entries if you haven't.

mike: Pinging owners on backports. If your PR isn't in the release notes, add a bullet under its component.

sre-bot: Reminder: changelog-lint run scheduled in 45m. Errors will block the release branch. :robot_face:

jordan: Quick Q — do we prefer 'bugfix' or 'fix' tag? I have a short patch for routing.

alexa: Use 'fix' per templates. Keep verbs imperative and present tense (e.g., 'fix cache eviction', not 'fixed' or 'fixes').

priscilla: If anyone needs the template, paste below.

alexa: ```
- component: runtime
  change: fix cache eviction for long sequences
  pr: #4521
  author: @priscilla
  reason: prevents OOMs when seq_len > 32k
```

mike: tiny nit — prefer single-line 'change' short summary, then an optional indented detail paragraph. Keeps the release notes compact.

jordan: Got it. I'll convert my PR notes now.

alexa: Also: if you rely on a dedicated bump, add 'aka: bump' label in the entry so release-tools picks it up.

priscilla: Can someone confirm branch name: release/v1.8.4 or v1.8.4-rc? I don't want to mis-tag the PR.

mike: We cut release/v1.8.4 from main after the lint pass. Use -rc only if we expect a hotfix candidate after the cut.

sre-bot: changelog-lint found 2 entries missing 'pr' field: #4521, #4539 — owners notified.

jordan: I've updated #4521 with pr and author. :white_check_mark:

alexa: Thanks. If you can't make the cutoff, add a quick comment on the PR with the 'release:skip' label so ops can triage.

priscilla: One last ask — keep examples/code snippets out of the short summary, put them under 'details' so the changelog stays compact.

mike: ACK. I'll run a final sweep 30m before cutoff and ping release-owner for the final green.

alexa: Great — tagging @release-owner to confirm final go/no-go in ~30m. :alarm_clock:
